frozen_by: CH-12 (2026-11-09, Badabuba / worker Claude); decision note results/ch-12-comparison/decision.md, rule results/ch-12-comparison/selection_rule.md, evidence results/ch-12-comparison/selection.json
family: query-based: Ultralytics RT-DETR-l (300 queries), the comparable family leader at the rubric budget

run_config.note: CH-14 final training frozen by CH-12. Identical to rtdetr_baseline (CH-11) except the training frames: train_final = every 4th frame of every train clip (6,072 frames) instead of train_rubric (2,800). 6 epochs = 36,432 images seen. imgsz 1344, batch 1, AMP, seed 42, flip-only, optimizer=auto (AdamW lr0 0.000833), 300 queries, frozen ignore policy (masked export).

train_split.name: train_final
train_split.rule: movd.data.every_kth_per_clip(train images, k=4): every 4th frame of every one of the 56 train clips, starting from the first frame (the val_fast rule applied to train)
train_split.image_ids_sha256_of: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(ids).encode()) of the list in movd.data.every_kth_per_clip order
train_split.class_mix: matches the full train set within 0.1 pp (person 29.8 / car 45.6 %); train_rubric over-represents person by 4.7 pp (results/ch-06-eda/tables/subsampling_class_mix.csv)
train_split.export: movd.ultra.export_split('train_final', 'train', ids, 'outputs/yolo_data_final', mask=True) for the masked train frames, plus the val_fast byte copy and write_data_yaml(..., 'train_final', 'val_fast'): the CH-09 export path and the frozen CH-02 ignore policy, unchanged. Ultralytics' validation stays off (val false)

not_changed_and_why.input size: kept 1344: RT-DETR has no result at another size; the CH-10 imgsz 1600 gain is YOLO11s-only evidence and would cost about 1.42x compute (selection_rule.md rule 5)
not_changed_and_why.epochs: kept 6: the validated schedule shape (3 warmup epochs, linear decay); the warmup fraction stays 3/6 because Ultralytics counts warmup in epochs. rtdetr_baseline val_fast peaks at epoch 3 (0.2691) and ends at 0.2617, so more passes over the same frames are not supported
not_changed_and_why.learning rate: kept auto: rtdetr_lr1e4_wb0 0.2179 < 0.2577 (rtdetr_lr1e4 0.1560 is confounded and not used)
not_changed_and_why.augmentation: kept flip only: no stronger-augmentation result exists in this project

expected_runtime.basis: rtdetr_baseline on the RTX 5070 Laptop GPU: 4,138 s for 16,800 images = 0.2463 s/image including the per-epoch overhead (results/rtdetr_baseline/ultralytics/results.csv; epochs 665-740 s); peak CUDA 3.55e9 bytes (3.31 GiB) allocated at batch 1 (results/rtdetr_baseline/runtime.json)
expected_runtime.schedule_fit: plan.md section 7: final training starts no later than Mon 22:00 Kyiv, so the job ends by about Tue 01:20 even in the worst case, before the Tue 08:00 no-new-jobs and Tue 12:00 experiment cut-offs; per-epoch checkpoints allow resume

fallback_and_second_selection.use: plan.md section 7 fallback if the final training is late or fails; also the internal-validation candidate for the second Kaggle final selection (G2c), compared with the final model on val_full in CH-14

ch14_implementation_note: scripts/train_ultra.py reads <data_yaml folder>/train_rubric_manifest.json for config.json and the --observe sample-count check. For train_final, CH-14 must make it read the manifest of the data.yaml train list (train_final_manifest.json), then smoke-test (stop after epoch 0 + resume) before the full run, as CLAUDE.md section 8 requires
inference: conf, NMS/query cap, max_det (<= 500), TTA and tiling are frozen by CH-13 in configs/runs/final_inference.json; RT-DETR returns at most 300 boxes per image (300 queries)
